messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating feature-flag rollout for `cohort_v2` on route `model-route-v3`. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 15% over 30m windows. Pinning to model build `2026-03-21-rc3` for canary. Change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Will auto-promote if telemetry OK.
alex: Copy. I'll watch p50/p95, error-rate (5m), and token cost counters. Posting quick dashboards.
tara: Heads-up — this flag touches session affinity. Adding a holdpoint after 5% to validate stickiness.
deploy-bot: Canary progressed: 1% -> 5% (promote at +18m). Holdpoint engaged at 5%.
sam: Noticing EU shard error-rate uptick: 0.2% -> 1.2% over last 3m. Also a small rise in p95 (150ms -> 220ms). Pausing the rollout. :eyes:
morgan: If error-rate >1% sustained 5m we pull. Recommend soft-disable cohort_v2 in EU and pin traffic back to `2026-03-20-stable`.
tara: Agreed. Execute soft disable for EU only, keep US canary at 5% until we validate. @deploy-bot can you run the soft-disable and pin?
deploy-bot: Running soft-disable: `deployctl toggle --flag cohort_v2 --region eu --off --drain 45s --note "eu error spike"`
alex: Running the command now from ops box, logs: ```
$ deployctl toggle --flag cohort_v2 --region eu --off --drain 45s
INFO: toggling cohort_v2 -> OFF (region=eu)
INFO: draining 23 inflight sessions
INFO: pinned route model-route-v3 -> 2026-03-20-stable
```
sam: Metrics look much better after drain, errors back to 0.25%. p95 trending down. :thumbsup:
morgan: Good. I'll file a follow-up to investigate KV-cache misses on EU nodes (suspected). Assigning to @tara to own the post-rollback check.
tara: Acknowledged. I'll run a targeted repro and add telemetry for affinity misses.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Final state: `cohort_v2` OFF in EU, US at 5% paused, global pin -> `2026-03-20-stable`. Release note: "cohort_v2 rollout aborted: investigating EU cache/affinity interaction"
alex: I'll update the release notes + internal changelog and mark the deploy as aborted in the release board. Thanks everyone for quick response.
sam: Quick retrospective: maybe tighten EU preflight next time (smaller canary or extra affinity smoke).
morgan: Agreed. We'll update the rollout playbook. Closing thread unless new issues crop up.
